title: Who is who in The Tiger King
back: Tiger King (hour of the Bull), astrologer (prophecy), dewan (zoo tiger, bride), British officer (fifty rings), the prince (wooden tiger).

title: The Tiger King in six beats
back: Prophecy → monopoly → fifty rings → marriage for tigers → the hundredth → wooden tiger.

title: Seventy tigers in ten years
back: The campaign begins at twenty; the state's tigers are wiped out. Dewan's warnings ignored; the near-misses survived.

title: The wooden tiger
back: A sliver from a cheap toy infects the king's hand; the operation succeeds, and the Maharaja dies.

title: Operation successful — Maharaja dead
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 200" role="img" aria-label="Ceremony that hides failure — Kalki's last joke" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" font-size="11"><rect x="60" y="60" width="200" height="80" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.85" stroke="none" rx="6"/><text x="160" y="96" text-anchor="middle" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#E0B400" stroke="none">operation</text><text x="160" y="118" text-anchor="middle" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#E0B400" stroke="none">successful</text><g><circle cx="136.9" cy="180.95" r="6.05" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.6" stroke="none"/><rect x="143.5" y="180.32" width="41.25" height="9.68" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.6" stroke="none" rx="3.63"/></g><text x="160.0" y="192" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-style="italic" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.85" stroke="none">Ceremony that hides failure — Kalki's last joke</text></svg>
back: The target: arrogant rulers, flatterers, bought officials, and the senseless killing of tigers.

title: The astrologer's bet
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 200" role="img" aria-label="Line to remember" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" font-size="11"><g><rect x="28" y="36" width="264" height="72" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.08" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" rx="10"/><path d="M50,108 L42,122 L64,108 Z" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.9" stroke="none"/><text x="160.0" y="68.2" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">I will cut off my tuft</text><text x="160.0" y="84.2" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">and become an insurance agent</text></g><text x="160" y="146" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.8" stroke="none">— if the king survives the hundredth tiger</text><text x="160.0" y="192" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-style="italic" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.85" stroke="none">Line to remember</text></svg>
back: A comic hedge that fixes the number one hundred in the reader's mind. Hyperbole and humour are the method of the satire.
